name: Bögöt (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of three stripes, white, blue and white, charged near the top of the blue with the municipal arms of Bögöt: a crowned blue shield with a white ploughshare, within a green wreath.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Bögöt arms with crown and wreath
